body:
Phase 4 items 4.1 + 4.2 (TICKET-DONE listener) of docs/specs/pi-native-flush.md (READ IT FIRST). Builds on merged Phases 1–3 of plugins/adlc-pi.

=== VERIFIED pi API FACTS (0.80.3; types in node_modules/@earendil-works/pi-coding-agent/dist/core/extensions/types.d.ts) ===
- `pi.registerTool(def)`: ToolDefinition with TypeBox `parameters` (import Type from 'typebox'; use StringEnum from '@earendil-works/pi-ai' for enums — Type.Union/Literal breaks Google providers), `execute(toolCallId, params, signal, onUpdate, ctx)`, optional promptSnippet/promptGuidelines (guidelines must NAME the tool — 'Use adlc_prosecute when…', never 'this tool'), renderCall/renderResult; THROW to signal error. Registration is live immediately.
- Subagents are NOT a pi API: the official pattern (examples/extensions/subagent/ in the pi package) spawns child `pi` subprocesses. Children use the user's configured provider/model — keyless by construction. `pi -p "<prompt>" --no-session` runs print mode; strict-LF JSONL applies only to rpc mode.
- `message_end` event: fires per finalized message; returns {message?} to replace. Assistant text is in the message content.
- @adlc/core prosecutor machinery (packages/core/lib/prosecutor.mjs — READ IT): LENSES, VERIFIER, dedupeFindings, survivesVerification, shouldContinue, findingKey, recordFinding; plus extractJson for tolerant JSON extraction from model output.

=== DELIVERABLES ===
1. lib/prosecutor.mjs: a deterministic P5 loop — fan out one fresh-context child per lens (LENSES) over the ticket's diff, dedupe (dedupeFindings), verify survivors (VERIFIER children + survivesVerification), loop until shouldContinue says stop (dry-pass convergence), recordFinding each confirmed finding to the .adlc ledger. The child runner is INJECTED (`runLens(prompt, {signal, timeout}) -> string`), with the default implementation spawning `<repoRoot>/node_modules/.bin/pi` (fall back to `pi` on PATH) in print mode with --no-session; bound children (default: max 4 concurrent, 120s timeout each, max 3 rounds) and surface which model answered when pi prints it. Unit tests use a scripted fake runner — no real spawns in `node --test`.
2. `pi.registerTool('adlc_prosecute')`: params { base?: string (git ref, default merge-base with main), ticket?: string (default active) }; execute() runs the loop and returns a structured summary ({rounds, findings: [...], dryPasses, verdict: 'CLEAN'|'FINDINGS'}) as the tool result text + details. Denied while the enforcement context is broken (same fail-closed posture as other gates). The existing adlc-prosecute prompt template (Phase 3) is updated to instruct calling the adlc_prosecute tool instead of prose-shelling.
3. Completion-protocol listener: on message_end, when the assistant message text ends with 'TICKET-DONE' (exact token, trailing whitespace tolerated), notify + sendMessage (deliverAs 'followUp') instructing the model to run adlc_prosecute before claiming completion, and record a 'ticket-done-claimed' evidence entry. 'TICKET-BLOCKED:' similarly records 'ticket-blocked' with the reason and notifies. Each fires at most once per turn; never rewrites the message.
4. Live smoke (bounded): extend the stub-provider approach of scripts/pi-live-deny.mjs into scripts/pi-live-prosecute.mjs — the stub provider's scripted turn calls adlc_prosecute with an injected fake runner? NO — the tool runs in-process with the real runner; instead the smoke verifies tool REGISTRATION + callability: the stub model calls adlc_prosecute with base=HEAD (empty diff → zero lenses → CLEAN verdict without spawning children). Assert the tool result reaches the model. Wire into CI Node-22 leg beside the live-deny step.

=== ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA ===
- AC1: with a fake runner scripted to return one finding from lens A in round 1 and nothing after, the loop dedupes, verifies (fake verifier votes), records the confirmed finding to the ledger, and converges per shouldContinue; the summary counts rounds/dry-passes correctly. VERIFY: node --test.
- AC2: a finding rejected by the verifier is NOT recorded and does NOT reappear as new in later rounds (dedupe vs seen, not vs confirmed). VERIFY: node --test.
- AC3: runner timeout/abort marks that lens errored WITHOUT failing the whole loop, and the summary reports the degraded lens. VERIFY: node --test with a hanging fake runner + short timeout.
- AC4: message_end with an assistant message ending 'TICKET-DONE' triggers exactly one notify + one followUp message + one evidence entry; a message merely CONTAINING the token mid-text does not; 'TICKET-BLOCKED: reason' records the reason. VERIFY: wiring tests.
- AC5: `node scripts/pi-live-prosecute.mjs` exits 0 (tool registered + callable end-to-end in a real pi loop); wired into ci.yml Node-22 leg. VERIFY: run + grep.
- AC6: full root `npm test` exits 0; scripts/pi-live-deny.mjs still passes.

Suppressions denied; marker fixtures by concatenation. Do not modify sibling plugins or packages/** (the prosecutor machinery in @adlc/core is consumed as-is; STOP and escalate if it lacks something).
title: pi Phase 4a: deterministic P5 prosecutor (fresh-context child pi sessions) + TICKET-DONE/BLOCKED listener
